scenes.caption: Baghdad.
scenes.say: Fatima visits Baghdad in the Golden Age of learning.

scenes.caption: A new idea.
scenes.say: A scholar writes a new idea in a book.

scenes.caption: Translators.
scenes.say: Translators from many faiths turn the book into other languages.

scenes.caption: A caravan.
scenes.say: The book travels on a camel caravan along trade routes.

scenes.caption: A compass.
scenes.say: On the sea, sailors use a compass to find north.

scenes.caption: Cordoba.
scenes.say: In Cordoba, scholars read the book and add their own ideas.

scenes.caption: A source.
scenes.say: Today we study letters and books as sources.

scenes.caption: Shared.
scenes.say: Shared knowledge grew, and it still shapes our world.
